name: Tsukigata Mitora
source:
Beautiful caretaker with eyes that can change its colour from yellow to green depending on the light. 
Has a habit to make up points for other people's actions. 
Likes: Singing, Snakes
Dislikes: Over-familiar people, Cigarettes
